entries.evidence: Target and candidate have equal 0x170 padded size and all 20 relocation identities/addresses. The remaining 11 normalized bytes are confined to the post-copy structure-field stores: VC7 chooses AX/CX for the type value, schedules the hardware-buffer reload at a different point, and moves one independent base-address store across the EDI restore. Broad declaration, field-order, barrier, helper, alias, qualifier, and topology matrices did not reproduce the target without regressing the exact prefix or relocation schedule.

Target and candidate have equal 0x160 padded size and all 24 relocation identities/addresses. The remaining eight normalized bytes are confined to the final four structure-field stores: the target reloads the hardware buffer into ECX before the offset/base stores, while VC7's current source reloads it into EAX after them. A preserved 160-case control-flow/barrier/field-order supersearch plus focused lifetime, alias, helper, qualifier, and initialization matrices found no legal-C form that changes only this schedule.

Audit and full inventory: research/asm_credited_functions_audit.md. Whole body is a single __asm block; no C remains. 2026-08-16 recovery attempt: expressible in C but a near-miss at 72/96. Semantically-correct C reaches 85 bytes off naively, 74 after moving the empty-needle return to the tail (the branch-polarity lever), and 72 with a while(*haystack) loop; prologue, csstrlen call, search loop and _strnicmp call all land correctly. Residue is a spill preference: January holds the first needle character in bl across the function and spills length into the dead needle parameter slot [ebp+0xc]; we keep length in ebx and spill the character to [ebp+0xf]. Measured inert: declaration order both ways, register on either/both locals, int/long/unsigned long length (int regresses to 103), length scoped inside the if, character hoisted out of the loop, continue- and while-form loops, length computed before the guard. Same spill class as the standing parks. Not replaced - swapping a byte-exact asm body for a 72-byte residual is not a recovery. See research/asm_credited_functions_audit.md. 2026-08-16 spill-flip attempt, refined: the 72-byte while(*haystack) form is STRUCTURALLY WRONG - it rotates the loop, duplicating the load/test at the back edge and forcing lea eax,[esi-1] instead of dec esi/mov eax,esi. The structurally correct form is the for(;;) at 74/96, whose loop body matches January instruction-for-instruction (load, inc, test, je, cmp, jne back-edge, strnicmp, test, jne back-edge, dec, return). Byte count is therefore the wrong metric here; 74 is closer than 72. With that structure fixed the residue is isolated to a single free-register contest: esi and edi hold haystack and needle in both builds, and exactly one of {first, length} can have ebx because both live ranges span a call (first across csstrlen, length across _strnicmp). January gives ebx to first (mov bl,[edi], cmp al,bl) and spills length into the dead needle slot [ebp+0xc]; we give ebx to length and spill first to [ebp+0xf] - which is also inside the dead needle slot, so both compilers reuse the same storage and differ only in which value wins the register. Additional inert levers measured this round: char/byte/unsigned char for the first character and the loop character, long/unsigned long/const long for the length, assignment inside the while condition, pointer-compare-before-increment, and length computed before the guard. Same free-register-preference class as the register-allocation parks; reachable in principle, lever not found. 2026-08-16 c2 debugger result (NEGATIVE, closes a line of investigation): built tools/c2dbg32/repro_stristr.c, a single-function TU reproducing the tie exactly (96B, ndiff 74, same mov ebx,eax for length and same spill of first to [ebp+0xf]), and breakpointed every mapped allocator site during its compile. The machinery runs - interference dispatch 0x1074d343 x6, relation 0x107091ae x8, overlap probe 0x10735a41 x5, interference test 0x1070943b x3, coalescing copy 0x10701961 x15, leaf-register write 0x10715873 x2, preference store 0x1075f5f2 x5, finalizer 0x107144cf x3 - but it never touches the registers in question: both leaf-register writes assign register byte 1, and ALL FIFTEEN coalescing copies propagate register byte 1 (ecx==1 at every hit). ebx/esi/edi are 3/6/7 zero-based and never appear. The mapped sites allocate the eax-family scratch class; the callee-saved assignment and the spill choice are made in a pass that is still unmapped. Further breakpoint work on these VAs therefore cannot reach this tie (nor the sibling register-mirror and spill parks). Progress needs the callee-saved/spill pass located from scratch - the entry point is the code that decides a live range is memory-resident, not the code that stamps [node+0x28]. See tools/c2dbg32/IR_LAYOUT.md. 2026-08-16 CORRECTION to this entry's earlier c2 claims: 0x10715873 does NOT write a physical register. Four probes differing only in the C type of the spilled locals show the byte it stamps into node[+0x28] is uniform across every node in a compile and tracks operand size - char->1, short->2, int->3, __int64->4 (13/13/13/7 hits, one distinct value each). It is an operand WIDTH class, not a register; thirteen simultaneously-live values cannot share one register. This also resolves the 'discrepancy' noted during the original record_kill work (rwprobe used short fields, every write showed al=2 while the code used ecx) - that was the width of a short, not a register quirk. Consequently the earlier 'read the register write' and 'traced the preferred-register argument' results for this function are WITHDRAWN: the physical-register assignment site and the spill decision are both still unlocated. The mechanism narrative (both candidate registers free, outcome set upstream) stands on the instruction-level evidence, but no compiler-internal site has been confirmed to make it. See tools/c2dbg32/IR_LAYOUT.md.

Audit and full inventory: research/asm_credited_functions_audit.md. __declspec(naked): no C body exists at all. 2026-08-16 recovery attempt: PROVABLY not expressible in C. The argument registers are live on entry (push eax with no preceding load) and the symbol is cdecl-decorated (_code_00148xxx, no @N) while the body does callee cleanup (ret 4). No standard convention produces that pair - measured: compiling the same body as __stdcall emits _code_00148xxx@4 and stops matching the target name. The only C route is VC7's private convention for a static with in-TU call sites, and these have no references anywhere in the tree, so an unreferenced static is eliminated. Park is now backed by proof rather than judgement.

Not compiler output. The body is Intel Application Note AP-930, 'Streaming SIMD Extensions - Matrix Multiplication' (June 1999, order number 245045-001), routine PIII_Mult00_3x3_3x3, which that note publishes as a __declspec(naked) __asm block; only its 6x6 routine is given in intrinsics. Aligning the two instruction streams, the first 31 SSE instructions are identical in order position for position and 39 of Intel's 47 appear in order across five contiguous runs; the eight that do not are where January interleaves the fourth row and the scale, which a pure 3x3 has no equivalent of. The shufps 0x36 that corrects a deliberately reversed 'up' row load and the shufps 0x8f that only permutes lanes before a store are both pessimisations no cost model emits, and both are Intel's verbatim. The compiler-shaped prologue (three lea, homed, reloaded into ecx/edx/eax) is what MSVC emits for C locals referenced from an __asm block, and maps onto Intel's src1/src2/dst. Parked because the original source was assembly and this project does not use assembly; a C form that reproduced these bytes would be a false reconstruction rather than a recovery. The committed C is semantically correct and marked NonMatching. Three independent searches (an external exhaustive 46,080-form first-row enumeration with all 40,320 store orders, our pointer-pressure sweeps, and the combination of both) all plateau near 293 differing bytes. Restored 2026-08-29: this entry and its intrinsics base are the verbatim owner-approved park from commit 2fdddb42, dropped during the units integration; the 2026-08-28 lab additionally proved a C wrapper around the verbatim __asm kernel compiles byte-exact (ledger matrix_math_obj_fable_vendored_kernel_recovery_20260828.md), which the no-assembly rule excludes from production.

PARKED FUZZY 2026-08-30 pending a later byte-match pass. House rule applied: the point_from_line3d COMDAT is no longer emitted (January's object has none), so the cluster-search advance is written out at the call site. COST, and the exact lever to restore when byte-matching resumes: CALLING the real_math.h __inline point_from_line3d(&test_point, &direction, offset, &test_point) reproduces January's schedule exactly (lcsd 8, 1327/1327 instructions, exact padded size and relocation identities/sequence, 348/348 frame-slot references) but emits a 48-byte COMDAT January lacks; every hand-written spelling of the same arithmetic canonicalises to one different schedule (lcsd 72, still 1327/1327 instructions). static __inline and __forceinline both still emit the COMDAT. NOTE this is systemic, not local: 121 objects emit 736 inline-helper symbols January lacks, which is consistent with linker COMDAT folding plus csplit attributing the single surviving copy to one owner object (action_charge owns point_from_line3d in January). Residual beyond the COMDAT question: two int-vs-x87 emission-order tie-breaks decoded with dbg32b (node-creation order, no order field).

Not a codegen difference. The loop bound is &thread_globals.mutex_references[MAXIMUM_MUTEX_REFERENCES].in_use, which is one past the end of the static thread_globals object (image 3262248, 1544 bytes) and therefore falls inside the next .bss symbol, transport_address_string (image 3263792, defined in source/bungie_net/network/transport_address.c). csplit recovers the target from the linked image and must attribute the destination to the symbol that contains it, so it spells relocation 2 as _transport_address_string+36; VC7 forms the same address from a C expression rooted in thread_globals and necessarily spells it _thread_globals+1580. Both resolve to image 3263828. Everything else is identical: size 64, 3 relocations at addresses 5/27/40 all of type 6, equal normalized bytes (3b67f561...), and all three resolved image destinations equal (3262548, 3263828, 3262512). No C source makes VC7 emit csplit's spelling; naming transport_address_string here would be a false declaration of an unrelated char[256] from another translation unit.

Equal size and relocations with 177/177 instructions; the whole function is identical except the order of two adjacent increments in the third do-while. January emits inc eax (channel_index), add ebx,2 (minimum_channel), add ecx,2 (the compiler's induction variable for next_source[CHANNEL_COUNT + channel_index]); we emit add ebx,2, inc eax, add ecx,2. The two user increments follow source statement order, but the generated induction variable does not follow either: source order minimum_channel++/channel_index++ emits min,idx,iv while channel_index++/minimum_channel++ emits idx,iv,min. January's idx,min,iv is not reachable from either. Measured inert: all seven positions of minimum_channel in the block declaration list, moving channel_index into the for-body block. Measured worse: comma-operator increments in both orders (lcsd 4), channel_index as short (170/177 insns), and replacing the minimum_channel walker with minimum_error[channel_index] indexing (170/177), which confirms the hand-written walker is correct.

Equal size and relocations with 105/105 instructions; the function differs only in where the integer load of dead_camera_constants.dead_timer is scheduled relative to the x87 negate/store of camera->facing.pitch. January emits mov edx,[dead_camera_constants]; fchs; add esp,0xc; fstp [esi+0x10]; we emit fchs; fstp [esi+0x10]; mov edx,[dead_camera_constants]; add esp,0xc. Both then store [esi+0x1c],edx at the same offset. Measured inert: giving camera->timer a named local to match the style of every other field in the function (distance, yaw, pitch, switch_timer, player_index, new_unit_index all go through one), and negating at the assignment instead of at the store. Measured worse: inlining the pitch temporary (blocks 3->4), moving the timer store ahead of the pitch store (lcsd 14), both together (lcsd 34), and assigning the timer local before the random call (100/105 instructions).
